title: Counterfactual STOP calibration with connected Horn distractors
parent_result: AF-19 graph-ancestry access gate passed but deep proof-search advantage failed
scientific_question: With the same graph-aware ancestor STOP readout, do exact truth-changing fact pairs and conditional connected-distractor invariance improve host-verified proof search over explicit STOP/reachability BCE at matched network forward-call budget?

data.logic: AF-17 original AND/OR Horn compositions unchanged, with novel physical permutations and exact source Horn closure
data.source: AF-19/17 train and dev byte-identical; source oracle is a finite BFS over reachable proved-atom sets
data.split_ownership: train for fitting; development for eligibility only; heldout unseen until weights frozen
data.pair_construction: Within an identical graph and layout, toggle exactly one initial fact on a graph-incidence path to goal; both members must have at least one enabled rule; semantic reachability flips or reachable minimum proof costs remain identical
data.no_label_leak: The network receives only public initial facts, rule incidence, current host-proved atoms and legal-action mask; reach truth, BFS cost and pair kind are supervision-only
data.manifest: fresh_manifest.json generated from exact public feature/pair rosters before scoring, pairwise disjoint from AF-16 through AF-19 historical scored heldouts

model.source: AF-19 ReadoutPolicy('ancestor') importing hash-pinned native TypedLoop(16)
model.host_gate: Only source-premise-enabled Horn rules can add a new proved head. STOP always legal. All accepted proofs independently checked.

fitting.same_minibatches: Same AF-17 legacy/composition samples and same paired source indices at each seed/loop in both training objectives
fitting.initialization: Identical full model parameters per seed for BCE and paired objectives and for both loop configurations
fitting.loss_primary: Exact AF-19 shortest-action CE +0.65(STOP-gap BCE +0.25 reach BCE) +0.55(legal-action Huber +0.5 distance Huber), cap16
fitting.loss_pair_common: 0.6 reach BCE +0.6 STOP gap BCE on both members (applied as 0.4 times loss)
fitting.loss_pair_extra: For truth-changing pairs: 0.4*(softplus(0.75 - signed reach-logit gap)+softplus(0.75 - signed STOP preference gap)); for connected-invariant pairs: 0.25*(mean squared probability reach difference + mean squared probability STOP gap difference), all times outer 0.4
fitting.budget_matching: Same model, same real input forwards and native-cell calls at each matched loop count, identical optimizer steps, samples and donor RNG. Extra pair losses add backward FLOPs so total FLOPs are not matched.
fitting.checkpoint: Fixed last update with separate Torch/NumPy exports and all source/dataset digests; no heldout-dependent selection
fitting.runtime: Local Python 3.13 Torch 2.10 CPU, two threads; hosted Python 3.12 Torch 2.5.1+cpu and Lean 4.19.0 if GitHub runners available

evaluation.eligible: All four arms must achieve >=0.65 original provable-goal proof success on both train and dev independently for a seed to count
evaluation.primary: Compare pair_l4 against bce_l4 separately on held_depth4 and held_depth5; L2 is mechanism/compute ablation
evaluation.scientific_gate: For each eligible seed, paired proof success exceeds BCE by >=0.05 on both held_depth4 and held_depth5; paired absolute success >=0.70; paired early STOP on provable cases <= BCE +0.02; flip paired joint-order accuracy >=0.75; connected distractor mean absolute reach and STOP probability changes <=0.10 and <= BCE+0.02; zero false accepted Horn proofs
evaluation.aggregation: Any eligible failure yields FAIL; every seed eligible and passing yields PASS; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
evaluation.pair_scores: Initial-state raw reach/STOP logits; signed flip preference order; outcome-preserving connected perturbation mean absolute changes for reachable equal-cost cases; no claim of invariance for arbitrary connected graph changes
evaluation.host_scores: Provable-goal proof success under exact minimum rule firings plus one, early STOP, false acceptance, fixed/uniform/shortest baselines
evaluation.audit: Independent public-physical-incidence Horn BFS, connected-graph distance, paired counterfactual target reconstruction, original proof-step legality, saved source/checkpoint hashes, Torch-NPZ weights, sampled neural policy and paired-state forward replay

formal_scope: Lean file proves elementary Boolean desired-STOP identities; complete model generalization is empirical and host-verified Horn traces have separate proof authority
failure_policy: Record all seeds, negative/ineligible results and runner failures. Preserve AF-01 through AF-19 and keep AF-20 draft and unmerged pending source-pinned evidence review.
